literal: Theoretical method known even when, of the world nature having known act.
translation: Even if you know the theoretical methods for a task, you must understand the practical nature of the world before acting.
modern: ஒரு செயலைச் செய்யும் முறைகளை முழுமையாக அறிந்திருந்தாலும், உலகத்தின் நடைமுறை இயல்பை நன்கு அறிந்து அதற்கேற்பச் செயல்பட வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts theoretical knowledge with practical wisdom. The word 'செயற்கை' refers to the artificial or theoretical methods of doing things, often learned from study. 'இயற்கை' refers to the natural state or practical reality of the world. The poet advises that even if a minister has mastered the theoretical methods of governance, they must observe and understand the actual conditions of the world before taking action.
